account: none (public endpoints only; no Google account/credentials used)
auth_method: none — unauthenticated public endpoints + authored shapes
note: auth mocks Google's OAuth2/OIDC surface. Success responses for token/userinfo/device flows require real OAuth client credentials, which this repo does not have for Google auth; those fixtures are AUTHORED from Google's public documentation response shapes and clearly marked below.

method_per_file.token_error_no_client.json: LIVE capture: POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token with no client (400)
method_per_file.userinfo_error_invalid_credentials.json: LIVE capture: GET https://openidconnect.googleapis.com/v1/userinfo with Bearer invalid (401)
method_per_file.device_code_error_invalid_client.json: LIVE capture: POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/device/code with bogus client_id (401)
method_per_file.revoke_error_invalid_token.json: LIVE capture: POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/revoke with token=invalid (400)
method_per_file.token_response.json: AUTHORED from https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2/web-server#exchange-authorization-code (needs real creds to capture)
method_per_file.token_refresh_response.json: AUTHORED from https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2/web-server#offline (needs real creds to capture)
method_per_file.userinfo.json: AUTHORED from https://developers.google.com/identity/openid-connect/openid-connect#obtainuserinfo (needs real creds to capture)
method_per_file.device_code_response.json: AUTHORED from https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2/limited-input-device#step-2 (needs real client_id to capture)
method_per_file.token_error_invalid_grant.json: AUTHORED from RFC 6749 / Google token endpoint documented error shape
